descriptionZh: End-to-end mobile game server emulator development for Android clients — a case-based operating system, not a one-game cheat sheet. Redirect the client to your host (APK/assets patch, DNS, adb reverse, Frida connect hook), capture and reverse HTTP/TCP/WebSocket traffic (mitmproxy, Protobuf, custom framing), bootstrap a minimal stub server with login → character → enter-world → heartbeat handlers, and tunnel via frp/ngrok for multiplayer. Includes: doctor/init-workspace/triage/decode/patch-endpoint/capture-traffic/proto-extract/frida-hook-run/server-bootstrap/tunnel-setup scripts; five stage playbooks; phase gates; PKT protocol notes; failure catalog; Python/Node stubs; Frida templates. Engines: Unity IL2CPP, Cocos, native Java. Companion skills: apk-reverse, rev-u3d-dump, rev-frida.
